title: Launch readiness orchestration: beta signal design, release-notes cadence, and lighthouse account enablement
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Objective: Prepare a repeatable orchestration for customer launches that ties together a lightweight beta program, formal lighthouse account enablement, and a single source of truth for release notes and public-facing change messaging.

Scope:
- Define signals and telemetry for beta readiness (engagement, error rates, latency, quality regressions).
- Create a release-notes cadence and templated content blocks for engineers, PMs, and support.
- Establish a lighthouse enablement checklist (infrastructure, onboarding, legal/contract readiness, escalation path).
- Coordinate go-to-market tasks: docs, blog post draft, customer webinar plan, CS onboarding slots.
- Define success criteria and rollback thresholds tied to platform SLOs and product quality signals.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: full enterprise sales enablement (handled by Sales Ops) and full legal contract templates (handled by Legal).
acceptance_criteria: A single launch readiness checklist exists and is accepted by Eng, Design, Support, and Sales (link to checklist in Drive)
Release-notes template and cadence doc published and scheduled in product calendar
Telemetry dashboard with beta-specific views (engagement, latency, error budget) created and linked to the checklist
Lighthouse account enablement flow documented with at least 3 pilot customers allocated and assigned CS owners
Runbook for rollback and fallback to compatible model variants drafted and reviewed by Runtime and Infra teams
updates: 2025-02-10 Asha Kapoor: Created ticket and high-level scope. Shared initial outline in #pm-launch Slack. Requested initial stakeholders from Eng/Console/Sales/CS.

2025-02-12 Priya Nair (ENG): Confirmed instrumentation owner for beta telemetry (ENG-2330). Will add dashboard panels for token latency, 95th/99th percentiles, and prefix-cache hit rate.

2025-02-13 Design review: Des provided initial onboarding checklist UI mockups (Drive: https://drive.google.com/des-onboarding-mock). Requested copy changes for step labels and added empty states for pending invites.

2025-02-14 Diego Martinez: Created pilot lighthouse list and reached out to three accounts (Acme Labs, Nimbus Health, Beacon Retail). CS owners assigned. Next: align legal on data processing notes and finalize webinar date.
risks: Telemetry gaps: missing KV cache hit metrics for older model variants could mask regressions
Release notes cadence might not align with urgent runtime patches, need escape hatch for hotfixes
Resource conflicts: Eng bandwidth for dashboard work may slip if higher-priority infra incident occurs
